info.title: OpenWrench Buyer API
info.description:
External REST API for OpenWrench buyers (facilities-management side). Generated from the application source (Play routes, controllers and models).

## Authentication
Every request must carry a buyer API key in the `X-API-KEY` header. The key resolves to a buyer contact, and all reads/writes are tenant-scoped to that contact's buyer company (plus, on several endpoints, role-based location/brand restrictions). Endpoints under `/v1/buyer/super_admin/...` (and a few others noted per-operation) additionally require the key's contact to be a buyer super admin.

## Rate limiting
10 requests per 20-second window per API key; requests beyond that receive **429**. A handful of operations noted per-operation bypass the rate limiter.

## Response envelope
Single-entity responses: `{ "type": "<EntityName>", "data": { ... }, "status": "ok" }`.
List responses: `{ "type": "<EntityName>", "data": [ ... ], "count": <total>, "status": "ok" }`.
count_by responses: `{ "type": "CountBy", "data": <integer>, "status": "ok" }`.
Errors: `{ "message": "...", "type": "<ExceptionType>", "status": "error", "traceId": "..." }` — 401 missing/invalid key, 400 bad input, 404 not found, 429 rate limit.

## Pagination & filtering
List endpoints accept `offset`, `limit` (default 10, max 25 — the locations list clamps to 10), `sort_by` and `order` (asc|desc). Every other query parameter is treated as a filter and matched against the entity's indexed columns (multi-value filters are comma-separated strings); these are combined with the tenant-security filters derived from the API key.

Timestamps are ISO 8601 strings unless noted otherwise.

## Date formats
Date-time fields serialize as strings in one of two shapes depending on the underlying type: ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. `2026-08-14T13:05:22.000-07:00`) for most timestamps, or `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.S` (space-separated, no offset) for database timestamp fields. Plain dates are `yyyy-MM-dd`. When sending date-times, ISO 8601 is accepted.

## Required headers
Every request must carry BOTH `X-API-KEY` (your API key) and `OW-KEY` (the OpenWrench shared secret issued with it). Requests missing either return 401.

note.description: The note to append (text and noteAddedBy required; noteAddedAt is replaced server-side). Technically optional — omitting it makes the call a no-op save.

patch.summary: Append photo notes to a work order in bulk
patch.description: Appends up to 25 photo-only notes to the work order's buyer↔supplier thread in one call and sends a single grouped notification instead of one notification per photo. Each note must carry a photo URL and no other content (empty text, no video, audio, otherFile, or elements), and the same photo URL cannot appear twice in one request. Every note's noteAddedBy is set to the calling contact and noteAddedAt is overwritten with the current server time, so the batch keeps the order it was sent in. The author's email is added to the work order's buyer subscriber list.

notes.description: Photo-only notes to append, in the order they should appear on the thread. Each entry must set photo and leave every other content field empty; photo URLs must be unique within the request.

400.description: Validation failure: notes is empty, has more than 25 entries, contains a note that is not photo-only, repeats a photo URL, or the payload could not be parsed.

post.description: Creates a buyer contact (and optionally a login) and sends an invite email. Roles are required and may not include admin or super-admin roles (403). The target facility defaults to the API key's facility; a supplied facilityId must belong to the same buyer company (403 otherwise). 400 with conflictException when an account or contact already exists for the email. If password is supplied a login is created immediately (invite email says "invited you to OpenWrench"); otherwise the invite asks the user to sign up. Admin roles force hasAccessToAllLocations=true and clear locationIds/brandIds.

items.description: Role names (case-insensitive); admin/super-admin roles are rejected.

facilityId.description: Target buyer facility; defaults to the API key's facility. Must be in the same buyer company.

password.description: If supplied, a login is created immediately with this password.

epaCertificationType.description: EPA 608 certification class; validated against the recognised classes — an unrecognised value is rejected with 400.

OwKeyAuth.name: OW-KEY
OwKeyAuth.description: OpenWrench shared secret. Required on every request alongside X-API-KEY; issued together with your API key.

type.description: Exception type, e.g. unauthorizedException, NotFoundException, BadRequestException, ParseException, InvalidInputDataException, ConflictException, UnexpectedException.

traceId.description: Trace id (a random 11-char alphanumeric string when no explicit trace applies).

Error.description: Standard error envelope. 401 = missing/invalid API key, 400 = bad input, 404 = not found, 429 = rate limit exceeded.

CountResponse.description: Envelope for count_by endpoints: data is a plain integer count.

fileName.description: Original file name (non-ASCII characters stripped on upload).

fileId.description: Opaque file identifier used for later download.

FileDetails.description: File reference: name plus storage identifier.

FieldType.description: Field type definition for asset type required/optional fields. Shape abridged (model not in provided sources).

Timings.description: Opening/closing timings for one weekday. Shape abridged.

Address.description: Postal address object. Shape abridged (model not in provided sources).

Contact.description: Contact record. Abridged: only fields observed in the provided sources are listed.

ProblemType.description: Work order problem type. Abridged: full model not in the provided sources.

id.description: Per-note row id (populated on read where the note store is normalized).

eventType.description: e.g. began_trip, trip_paused, trip_resumed, arrived, started_work, ended_work, location_started, location_paused, location_resumed, ...

hourlyRate.description: Populated only for techs of the buyer's own internal service team; third-party rates are never exposed.

trueWorkTimeMillis.description: Work time in milliseconds with pause spans subtracted; null when work logs were not requested or not permitted.

ExpandedServiceCall.description: Response shape for the /with_* expansion routes: each optional section is present iff its with_* path segment was in the request.

WorkOrder.description: Work order. ABRIDGED: the full case class has 150+ fields (hydrated approval hierarchies, budgets, troubleshooting answers, contractor/sub-contractor details, internal workspaces, labels, stars, etc.); only the commonly used fields are listed here and additional properties may appear in responses.

Location.description: Location. Abridged: hydrated contact/settings arrays and brand/facility/company objects may also appear in responses.

readingMode.description: Defaults to direct_reading when not supplied on create.

AssetMeter.description: Asset meter. Hydrated asset/meterType/location objects may also appear in responses.

Asset.description: Asset. ABRIDGED: the full case class carries further fields (warranties, depreciation, spend rollups, meters, refrigerant retrofit plan, equipment/purchase-order links, etc.) that may appear in responses.

SupplierFacility.description: Supplier facility. Abridged: parsed service-area addresses, business codes, social media, webhook details and review tag rollups may also appear.

vendorCode.description: External-API alias of supplierCode (present on invoice responses).

relationshipStatus.description: NotInvited, Invited, UnResponsive, Connected or SelfManaged.

status.description: draft, pending, approved, processing, paid or void (persisted lowercase).

Invoice.description: Invoice (external API projection). ABRIDGED: further fields (invoice type templates, custom field values, approval hierarchy, revision changes, AI-parse metadata, watermarked PDFs) may appear. On external responses buyerSupplierRelationship additionally carries vendorCode.

InvoiceForDownload.description: Flattened invoice row for spreadsheet-style export. Custom-field maps also appear.

status.description: Proposal status (persisted lowercase); drafts are never returned on this API.

Proposal.description: Quote proposal. Abridged: approval hierarchy, capex/R&M category and revision-change fields may also appear.

items.description: Walkthrough task answer (shape abridged; may reference work orders the caller can read).

Walkthrough.description: Site survey walkthrough (read-only on this API). Abridged: hydrated site survey, project, subscriber contact objects may also appear.

status.description: PM status (e.g. Active, Paused, Expired); serialized via a custom format.

basedOn.description: What the schedule is based on: location, asset, assetType, meter or meterType.

frequency.description: Frequency expression (e.g. every-N-weeks / every-N-months forms); serialized via a custom format.

PlannedMaintenanceSchedule.description: Planned maintenance schedule. Abridged: hydrated template, trigger condition, meter, asset and run-log objects may also appear; status/frequency use custom serializations.

APIBuyerMe.description: Identity of the calling buyer API key: contact + facility + company. Deliberately small projection.
